event_relevance.description: Optional allowlist that narrows which calendar events get agent-generated prep / debrief. Solo blocks and personal-block titles are still skipped regardless. If both lists are empty or absent, every non-blocked event is prep-worthy (the default).

keywords.description: Case-insensitive substrings. An event matches if its title contains any of them (e.g. 'NTU', 'EDB').

domains.description: Email domains. An event matches if any attendee address ends with one of them (e.g. 'sequoia.com').
